battlecards.why_selected: Kept full athenaOne suite at a market-competitive 3.15 % fee while avoiding a reported $9 M early-termination penalty and disruptive system migration.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year rate addendum effective 9/1/22, 3.15 % of collections with retroactive credit to 9/1; price-lock through Jan-2025; quarterly volume tiers preserved.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Independent benchmarking showed Advantia was 40–60 bps above peers; client signalled willingness to move to Collector or bid the business six months before 2025 expiry.
supplier_strengths: High switching costs protect data continuity
battlecards.switching_costs: ≈$9 M contractual penalty plus workflow retraining and data migration risk.
battlecards.notes: Savings booked retroactively; Advantia to secure final contract amendment.
complexity_reasons: Threat of supplier switch used as leverage

battlecards.why_selected: Provided best BAFO pricing across formularies, agreed to extend 60-day terms and add enterprise service resources; enabled single-supplier model across Mid-Atlantic & Heartland.
battlecards.contract_terms: Draft prime-vendor agreement: 3-year term with two 1-year renewals, formulary compliance incentives, quarterly business reviews.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to shift 100 % of Heartland volume away from Medline; competitive pressure from 4 national distributors.
supplier_weaknesses: Historically weaker service levels in Heartland region (to be addressed in SLA)
battlecards.switching_costs: Staff retraining on ordering portal and SKU cross-references; change management mitigated via phased roll-out plan.
key_contacts: Kirk Volm – Field VP Corporate Accounts
battlecards.notes: McKesson will supply all 24 practices; implementation start 10/31/22.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing was not competitive in BAFO round and could not match enterprise service requirements; lost Heartland region when volume was consolidated to McKesson.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher cost on core formulary SKUs
Separate regional agreement created administrative burden
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal—overlapping product SKUs available through McKesson; main effort is SKU cross-mapping.
battlecards.notes: Final Medline orders phased out by 12/1/22.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Per-scan rate out of market and unwillingness to meet scheduling KPIs; failed to engage during negotiations.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Demonstrated 18-24 % cost reduction through perm-hire model; supplier unresponsive to rate-down requests.
battlecards.switching_costs: Need to recruit sonographers and manage scheduling internally—addressed via phased hiring plan.
battlecards.notes: Services ramped down Q3-22; final invoices paid 8/31/22.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Advantia chose fully in-house recruiting for 80 % of demand; Staffmark may be used ad-hoc for overflow (no committed contract).
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Offered 22–24 % savings relative to incumbent, but still higher long-term cost than direct hire model.
battlecards.notes: Kept as contingency vendor; no savings booked.

battlecards.why_selected: Offered 10 % BAFO reduction while maintaining existing phlebotomy staff, LIS interface and specimen logistics.
battlecards.contract_terms: Pricing locked for 24 months; quarterly utilization reviews.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest BAFO showed 19 % savings, creating credible switch threat.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing than Quest on several high-volume tests
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-credentialing and patient workflow disruption; new courier routes.
battlecards.notes: Final contract execution targeted 10/15/22; savings begin Nov-22.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Operational change deemed too disruptive despite higher savings; incumbent LabCorp retained.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest’s aggressive BAFO used to secure lower pricing from LabCorp.
supplier_strengths: Lowest pricing on 80 % of top tests
supplier_weaknesses: Would require replacing existing in-practice staff and interfaces
battlecards.switching_costs: Lab IT integration, courier transition, re-training clinical staff.
battlecards.notes: Treya recommends reevaluating Quest after new LabCorp contract term.
complexity_reasons: Supplier used as leverage in negotiation

summary.skipped_reason: Suppliers in IUD Order Management, Bayer CIC program, Office Supplies, Telecom, and IT MSP were skipped: either simple policy changes or sourcing still in progress.
